answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments and VRF sortition, alongside sequential delay functions, forge an information-theoretic defense against identity cloning. Fabricating an identity proves computationally infeasible given the delay and Byzantine fault tolerance enforcing unforgeable cryptographic finality. Traversing the cryptographic canyon of these commitments and committing a forged copper saffron token is impossible, neutralizing Sybil attacks via secure primitives.
